requirements.text: [Need] Customers need a consolidated view of products, suppliers, sites, and shared data
[Need] Customers need approved assessment examples linked to every affected product
[Need] Customers need automatic certification-data checks and reminders for missing information
[Need] Customers need confidence that shared data reflects the latest review state
[Need] Customers need confirmation when TUV receives or reviews a submission
[Need] Customers need dependable alerts when deficiency questions require a response
[Need] Customers need field-level history for shared data changes and review actions
[Need] Customers need one place for certification status, documents, decisions, and messages
[Need] Customers need project notifications independent of access permissions
[Need] Customers need quotation cost components and assessment-module rationale before acceptance
[Need] Customers need reminders when product information changes in another system
[Need] Customers need scoped roles for viewing and changing certification data
[Need] Customers need service-grouped documents with consistent names
[Need] Customers need submitted application documents to remain visible in the project
[Need] Customers need the required fields and documents for each selected service
[Need] Customers need their change-notification ID retained through the TUV process
[Need] Customers need timing metrics to plan certification work and resources
[Need] Customers need to acknowledge notifications without downloading documents
[Need] Customers need to add product information when it becomes available
[Need] Customers need to approve consequential certification-data updates before application
[Need] Customers need to edit product, site, supplier, and relationship records directly
[Need] Customers need to find projects by product and customer-side identifiers
[Need] Customers need to follow up on requests without leaving the record
[Need] Customers need to import or reuse product-family data instead of entering each reference
[Need] Customers need to reuse European Database on Medical Devices (EUDAMED) product data
[Need] Customers need to see certification timing and the current process step
[Need] Customers need to submit certification requests before TUV creates a project
